info.description: Several fretboard patterns over ONE shared diagram, switched by pills. For a scale system that spans the neck (five pentatonic boxes, seven 3NPS shapes): stacking that many fretboards makes the page unreadable, and a shared fret window lets the reader watch the patterns climb the neck instead of each one being re-cropped. Renders through NeckPatternPicker in client/src/components/lesson/NeckPatternPicker.tsx.

patterns.description: Array of { label, sub?, dots[] }, two or more. A json column rather than a nested repeatable component ON PURPOSE: Strapi populates a dynamic zone exactly ONE component deep (`body: { populate: '*' }`), so a pattern's own `dots` would come back as an empty array at render — a picker of empty necks, no error anywhere. Shape is still fully validated on the MCP write path by lesson-blocks.ts. Same trade lesson.table's headers/rows already make.

fromFret.description: Shared fret window for the whole set, so every pattern draws at the same scale. Set both fromFret and toFret or neither.
